# cubepath_cdn_rule (Resource)

Manages a CDN edge rule on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_config` (String) Action configuration as JSON string.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `rule_type` (String) Edge rule type: cache, cache_bypass, redirect, header_request, header_response.
- `zone_uuid` (String) The UUID of the CDN zone.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `match_conditions` (String) Match conditions as JSON string.
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority (1-10000).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the rule.
